answer: At the butter table the pats are shaped by hand in the wooden butter hands, ridged once across the top so the pats stack neat. Rind rennet cheesemaker butter licence rules the shaping: a licence rennet cheesemakers carry after cheese cellar reviews. The ridge opens the shaping, the plume watches the pats, the copper shuts the butter. A cheat must do 151 false pats and 151 false shapings.
